title: Finals records
description: Settings of the workflows chosen as finals (data/art/finals/<set>.json), one record per generated workflow name (Hero_Engine_Stage). Written by `comfy_workflows.py finals record` from the finals kept in workflows/_final and replayed by `make`: the same seed (set to fixed), denoise and turbo with the new prompt. A record may be edited by hand.

seed.description: The seed of the render; make sets it with its control fixed

turbo.description: The Lightning LoRA (few steps) on or off

inputs.description: Every image the final loaded (the original photo, a Prime image, ...)

render.description: The counter of the render it came from (Hero_Engine_Stage_00015_)
